value.rationale: Fair length is a recently studied binary scattered-subsequence factorization measure. Relative to the published sharp bound four for arbitrary Thue–Morse factors, the result gives every prefix optimum, strict bound three, unique optimal two-cuts, exact natural densities and an aperiodic profile in one symbolic all-length theorem; these reveal genuine boundary/symbol interaction not an arbitrary finite slice.
